output.reason: The evidence states that (1) applicable charges for switching loans from floating to fixed (and other service charges/administrative costs incidental to exercising the options) must be transparently disclosed in the sanction letter and at the time of revision, (2) the applicable charges shall be as approved by the Board, and (3) the applicable charges shall be displayed on the UCB’s website. However, the evidence does not explicitly mention that these requirements are an “RBI rule,” so that part of the claim is not fully supported.
